subject.title: feat(sandbox): add skipSkillsSync config option to suppress skill sync

question: Should skill-sync suppression remain a Docker-only deployment option with a canonical preinstalled-skill root, or become a backend-neutral sandbox capability?
rationale: The branch adds a permanent public configuration contract across a multi-backend sandbox architecture, and code alone cannot choose whether Docker ownership or a generic sandbox capability is the intended product boundary.

options.title: Keep It Docker-Only
options.body: Retain the setting under `sandbox.docker`, gate all effects to the Docker backend, and require a canonical sandbox-readable skill root before advertising locations.

options.title: Make It Backend-Neutral
options.body: Move the setting to the generic sandbox config and define equivalent materialization and readable-path behavior for Docker, SSH, and OpenShell.

options.title: Pause The Feature
options.body: Close or defer the PR and continue automatic synchronization until a lower-surface capability or deployment pattern is designed.

recommendation.title: Keep It Docker-Only
recommendation.body: Retain the setting under `sandbox.docker`, gate all effects to the Docker backend, and require a canonical sandbox-readable skill root before advertising locations.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work defines the current materialized-skill and prompt-path invariant most directly affected by this product choice.
